scripts.dev:lan: echo "Móvil: http://$(ipconfig getifaddr en0):3000/en" && next dev -H 0.0.0.0
scripts.cert: mkdir -p certificates && mkcert -key-file certificates/localhost-key.pem -cert-file certificates/localhost.pem localhost 127.0.0.1 ::1 $(ipconfig getifaddr en0)
scripts.dev:https: npm run cert && echo "Móvil: https://$(ipconfig getifaddr en0):3000/en" && next dev -H 0.0.0.0 --experimental-https --experimental-https-key ./certificates/localhost-key.pem --experimental-https-cert ./certificates/localhost.pem
